note: Rhea County park on a Watts Bar Lake arm of the Piney River near Spring City: wooded loops around a bathhouse with showers, plus a day-use peninsula with swim area and fishing pier. No hookups and no dump station. --Claude
summary: Rhea Springs: county Facebook page (headless, logged out) + govserv.org mirror of its 2026 posts, Google panel, Esri read. $22 out-of-county ($10 county residents), cash only, FCFS, 14-day limit; 2026 season May 15 - Nov 2. No website besides the county's Facebook page. Pin ~260 m off the loops. Waterfront left 'not waterfront' (no site numbers; possible lakeview flagged).
